gui.floraferox.jei.bench_info: The Grafting Bench splices seeds: wheat seeds and a flower like a herb give that herb's seeds; a herb's seeds and an Ember Graft give its burning strain; burning seeds and a Rime Graft its frozen strain. It is also the Weedwarden's workstation: a villager who takes it trades her goods for the monsters' tokens.
gui.floraferox.jei.brew_info: Brewed into an Awkward Potion, a herb gives its family's drink.
gui.floraferox.jei.den_info: A Thorn Hopper Den: Thorn Hoppers come from it and return to it.
enchantment.floraferox.heartsight.desc: Adds a heart ring sight; sneak to aim down it (the view zooms in).
enchantment.floraferox.seed_hopper.desc: One Seed Pellet in three is not spent: half as many shots again from the same pellets.
enchantment.floraferox.weedkiller.desc: More damage to plant creatures (Flora Ferox's monsters, creepers).
enchantment.floraferox.bloom_shot.desc: Slower, bigger shots that burst on impact: petals, a ring of flame or a frost nova.
enchantment.floraferox.heartmend.desc: Shots heal allies instead of hurting, and seek them out. They never harm anything.
